step.cmd: Determine who you are trying to reach:

ul.li: If it is the employer, go to step 52.
If it is the client, go to step 57.

step.cmd: Determine if the employer is an interested party in the request for reconsideration:

ul.li: If yes, go to step 53.
If no, go to step 54.

step.cmd: In ACS, create and send the X-04-00-00 letter. Based on the claim information, select all of the required attributes, including the following:

ul.li: Acknowledgement and Request call back from Employer (11830)
This letter replaces or Footnote Employer (2365)

Text - Footnote (11745): Type “You may call any weekday up to and including [today’s date + 10 working days] between the hours of [list hours of work, including the time zone]. The sooner you contact us, the sooner we can process this request.”
Go to step 55.

step.cmd: In ACS, create and send the Z-00-00-00. Based on the claim information, select all of the required attributes, including the following:

ul.li: Employer or Third Party Name (1334) .
Employer or Third Party Address 1 (1336) .
Employer or Third Party Address 2 (2440) .
Employer or Third Party Address 3 (2441) .

Text - Free Text (1612): Enter the issue you are enquiring about and type “You may call any weekday up to and including [today’s date + 10 business days] between the hours of [hours of work, including the time zone] at the following telephone number: [your telephone number].”

step.cmd: In NWS, add details to the draft SROC created during fact-finding or create a new SROC as follows:

ul.li: Main Issue: Select Request for Reconsideration .
Comments: Type “RFR [ADMS record number] — [issue] — [employer name and LDW, if necessary] — [party being called].”

Details: Type “No communication by telephone with the client [and why, if no attempts were made]. [X-04-00-00 or Z-00-00-00] letter has been sent. Response due [today’s date + 10 business days].” If not already documented, enter your telephone number in case the employer contacts the call centre.
Select Draft .

step.cmd: In NWS, move the WI to Pending as follows:

ul.li: Pending reason: Select Fact finding (employer).
Comments: Type “Awaiting response to letter [X-04-00-00 or Z-00-00-00] sent on [DD-MM-YYYY].”
Bring forward date: Enter today’s date + 10 business days.
Go to step 60.

step.cmd: In ACS, create and send X-03-00-00 letter. Based on the claim information, select all of the required attributes, including the following:

ul.li: Acknowledgment and Request call back from claimant (11913)
This letter replaces or Footnote Employer (2365)

Text - Footnote (11745): Type “You may call any weekday up to and including [today’s date + 10 business days] between the hours of [list hours of work, including the time zone]. The sooner you contact us, the sooner we can process this request.”

step.cmd: In NWS, add details to the draft SROC created during fact-finding or create a new SROC as follows:

ul.li: Main Issue: Select Request for Reconsideration .
Comments: Type “RFR [ADMS record number] — [issue] — [employer name and LDW, if necessary] — [party being called].”

Details: Type the appropriate option:
“Unable to validate the client’s identity by telephone. X-03-00-00 letter has been sent. Response due [today’s date + 10 business days].” If not already documented, enter your telephone number in case the client contacts the call centre.
“No communication by telephone with the client [and why, if no attempts were made]. X-03-00-00 letter has been sent. Response due [today’s date + 10 business days].” If not already documented, enter your telephone number in case the client contacts the call centre.
“Unable to reach the client by telephone — no telephone number on file.”
Select Draft .

step.cmd: In NWS, move the WI to Pending as follows:

ul.li: Pending reason: Select Fact finding client .
Comments: Type “Awaiting response to letter X-03-00-00 sent on [DD-MM-YYYY].”
Bring forward date: Enter today’s date + 10 business days.

step.cmd: When the WI moves the current workload, determine if the party responded:

ul.li: If yes, go to step 61.
If no, go to Unable to complete the call . Unable to complete the call

step.cmd: Determine if it is a client returning the call:

ul.li: If yes, refer to Validating a client’s identity when communicating by telephone and go to step 62. Validating a client’s identity when communicating by telephone
If no, go to Completing the call . Completing the call

step.cmd: Determine if the client’s identity could be validated:

ul.li: If yes, go to step 63.
If no, go to step 65.
If the client’s address is the same as the one on file, go to step 64.
If the client’s address is different than the one on file, refer to Change of address , then go to step 64. Change of address

step.cmd: In NWS, add details to the draft SROC or create a new SROC as follows:

ul.li: Main Issue: Select Request for Reconsideration .
Comments: Type “RFR [ADMS record number] — [issue] — [employer name and LDW, if necessary] — [party being called].”

Details: Type “The client’s identity and address have been validated.” Document the fact-finding details according to the National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy . National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy
Select Draft .
Go to Completing the call . Completing the call

step.cmd: In NWS, add details to the draft SROC created when attempting to contact the party or create a new SROC as follows:

ul.li: Main Issue: Select Request for Reconsideration .
Comments: Type “RFR [ADMS record number] — [issue] — [employer name and LDW, if necessary — [party being called].”

Details: Type “Unable to validate the client’s identity by telephone.” Document any additional details according to the National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy . National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy
Select Draft .
Go to Unable to complete the call . Unable to complete the call
